items.quote: What is the mean number of cases recorded across all countries and years?
items.description: 計算 'No. of cases' 欄（轉為 Int64、忽略 Null/空白）所有國家與年份的平均值，與 answer.txt 的 @mean_cases 值比對。
answer.txt 必須含 @mean_cases 項目，值為正整數。

items.quote: Write your final answer to `answer.txt` in the root of this workspace.
items.description: answer.txt 需存在，且以 @mean_cases[value] 格式撰寫答案。

items.quote: Convert the data type of 'No. of cases' column from Object (string) to Int64 before performing calculations.
items.description: 計算前須將 'No. of cases' 由字串轉為 Int64；以 mean_int_col 重算即隱含此轉換，與交付值比對。

items.quote: Ignore those records where 'No. of cases' column value is Null or empty.
items.description: Null 或空白的 'No. of cases' 紀錄不計入平均；mean_int_col 重算即忽略 Null/空白，與交付值比對。
